critic.fix_suggestion: Modify the window primitive array along the fuselage side to introduce non-uniform spacing. Specifically, identify the 'Main deck door' locations and apply a 15% increase in gap distance between windows on either side of these doors. For the 'Upper deck' hump area, replace the linear dot pattern with a series of 0.2x0.4 unit rectangular primitives spaced at 0.5 unit intervals, following the curvature of the hull to match the reference geometry.

discrepancies.observed: A single continuous horizontal strip of small dots on the hump.
discrepancies.reference: A distinct row of individual rectangular windows following the curve of the upper deck.
discrepancies.direction_of_fix: Replace dots with a series of small, repeated box geometries along the hump's curvature.

discrepancies.observed: No visible door frames or recessed lines for passenger entry.
discrepancies.reference: Clearly defined rectangular outlines and seams for main cabin doors.
discrepancies.direction_of_fix: Add thin, slightly inset rectangular planes to represent door frames on the fuselage side.

discrepancies.observed: A single large dark block representing the cockpit area.
discrepancies.reference: Multiple distinct panes with defined structural dividers (mullions).
discrepancies.direction_of_fix: Subdivide the front nose geometry into 4-6 individual flat planes to represent separate windows.

discrepancies.observed: Windows are perfectly linear and uniform in size.
discrepancies.reference: Windows vary slightly in shape and spacing, particularly near the wing root and doors.
discrepancies.direction_of_fix: Adjust the spacing of window primitives to create gaps around door locations.
